desc.zh: 插入最大值，数清新增逆序对，再让相邻计数和共享计算。
desc.en: Insert the largest value, count its new inversions, then reuse neighboring sums.

concepts.name: Insertion counting bijection
concepts.description: Insert the unique maximum to add exactly the number of smaller values to its right.

concepts.name: Sliding sum over a DP row
concepts.description: Add the entering count and remove the expired count while retaining separate previous and current rows.
